description: This is a PHP source file for the 'PickList' module of the vtiger CRM project. It handles permissions, module selection, and picklist configuration through web interface, utilizing Smarty templates for rendering.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering UI views.

methods.name: getPickListModules
methods.description: Retrieves list of modules that have picklist fields.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Gets language strings specific to a module.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has administrator privileges.

methods.name: getUserFldArray
methods.description: Retrieves user-specific picklist entries for the module and role.

methods.name: get_available_module_picklist
methods.description: Gets available picklist options for the selected module and role.

methods.name: getrole2picklist
methods.description: Returns list of roles for picklist access management.
